chunks: Never so, for when life withdraws into the clavicula,

key_terms.التَّرَاقِيَ: The clavicles or collarbones, referenced here as the point from which the soul departs during death.

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'trāqī' (clavicles) signify in the context of death in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Qiyamah highlights the physical reality of death, where the soul's extraction is marked by the rising of the clavicles, symbolizing the finality of worldly life. It serves as a poignant reminder of the inevitability of divine reckoning, urging believers to prepare their souls before the breath is fully drawn out. This moment is often linked to the concept of *Barzakh*, the intermediate realm where the soul awaits the Day of Judgment.
